name: Pipeline de Gestión Automatizada de Vulnerabilidades (VMP)

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    a.id, 
    a.name AS asset_name, 
    a.software, 
    a.ecosystem, 
    a.version, 
    e.name AS env_name, 
    e.business_criticality AS env_criticality
FROM assets a
JOIN environments e ON a.environment_id = e.id
WHERE a.software = '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.name }}'
  AND a.ecosystem = '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.ecosystem }}'
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno }}' = 'TODOS' 
      OR e.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno }}'
  )
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo }}' = 'TODOS' 
      OR a.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo }}'
  );

INSERT INTO vulnerabilities_ignored 
(package_name, ecosystem, vulnerable_range, patched_version, ignored_at, hit_count)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.name }}', 
  '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.ecosystem }}', 
  '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.vulnerable_version_range }}', 
  '{{ $json.first_patched_version || "N/A" }}',
  NOW(),
  1
)
ON CONFLICT (package_name, vulnerable_range) 
DO UPDATE SET 
    ignored_at = NOW(),
    hit_count = vulnerabilities_ignored.hit_count + 1;

INSERT INTO public.vulnerabilities_audit 
(
    detected_at, 
    asset_id,
    cve_id, 
    ghsa_id, 
    cvss, 
    exploited, 
    priority, 
    decision, 
    assigned_to, 
    status
) 
VALUES (
    NOW(), 
    {{ $json.id || $json.asset_id || 0 }}, -- Intenta con 'id', si no 'asset_id', y si no pone 0 para que no sea undefined
    '{{ $json.cve_id || "N/A" }}', 
    '{{ $json.ghsa_id }}', 
    '{{ $json.cvss }}', 
    {{ $json.is_cisa_kev ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}, 
    '{{ $json.priority }}', 
    '{{ $json.action_plan.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    'SIN_ASIGNAR', 
    'DETECTADA'
);

INSERT INTO public.scan_reports (
    executed_at, 
    total_detected, audited, ignored, 
    criticals, highs, mediums, lows, 
    system_status, report_message, 
    environment_breakdown, 
    target_type, 
    target_name
) 
VALUES (
    NOW(), 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.total_items }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.auditados }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.ignorados }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.criticos }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.altas }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.medias }}, 
    {{ $json.ejecucion_stats.detalle.bajas }}, 
    '{{ $json.ejecucion_stats.status_sistema }}', 
    '{{ $json.ejecucion_stats.resumen.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ejecucion_stats.entornos) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo !== "TODOS" ? "ACTIVO" : ($("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno !== "TODOS" ? "ENTORNO" : "GLOBAL") }}',
    '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo !== "TODOS" ? $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo : ($("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno !== "TODOS" ? $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno : "TODOS") }}'
);

INSERT INTO public.assets (
    name, 
    software, 
    ecosystem, 
    version, 
    environment_id, 
    last_scan, 
    description
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.name }}', 
    '{{ $json.software.toLowerCase().trim() }}', 
    '{{ $json.ecosystem.toLowerCase().trim() }}', 
    '{{ $json.version.trim() }}', 
    {{ $json.environment_id }}, -- 🚀 Ahora inyecta dinámicamente en el entorno 1, 2 o 3
    NOW(), 
    '{{ $json.description }}' -- 🚀 Ahora guarda el texto con el detalle del CVE
) 
ON CONFLICT (software, version, environment_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    last_scan = NOW(),
    description = EXCLUDED.description;

INSERT INTO public.system_errors (
    node_name, 
    error_message, 
    workflow_id, 
    execution_id
) 
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted }}', 
    '{{ $json.execution.error.message }}', 
    '{{ $json.workflow.id }}', 
    '{{ $json.execution.id }}'
);
